Rf=470k with A~30 gives Zt≈113 dB. GBW is about 1 GHz on a ~10 fF node, so f0=sqrt(GBW*f_in)≈25 MHz and Q≈0.8. Rf noise is about 210 fA at 125 C. PARAMS = {
    "Rf":     (470e3, 420e3, 600e3),   # feedback resistor -> Zt and noise
    "Cf":     (3e-15, 0.5e-15, 20e-15),# small Rf bypass to tame peaking from the SF pole
    "I1":     (6e-6, 3e-6, 9e-6),      # gain-stage current (PMOS CS)
    "gmid1":  (12.0, 9.0, 15.0),       # PMOS input gm/Id (trade: Vsd headroom vs vout low limit)
    "L1":     (0.35, 0.2, 0.8),
    "Isf":    (5e-6, 3e-6, 8e-6),      # follower current (pole gm_sf/CL)
    "gmidsf": (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),      # high gm/Id -> small Vgs_sf (headroom)
    "Lsf":    (0.25, 0.15, 0.6),
    "Lb":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),         # mirror length (ref + sinks)
    "gmidb":  (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    cpd, cl = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13), spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Rf, Cf = p["Rf"], p["Cf"]
    I1, Isf = p["I1"], p["Isf"]
    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300.15

    # --- PMOS CS input: vin = VDD - Vsg1 ; ampout = vin + Vgs_sf ; Vsd1 = Vsg1 - Vgs_sf
    m1 = lut.size("p", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.35)
    vin = VDD - m1.vgs
    msf = lut.size("n", p["gmidsf"], p["Lsf"], Isf, vds=max(VDD - (vin + 0.7), 0.3), vsb=vin)
    vamp = vin + msf.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("p", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=max(VDD - vamp, 0.15))

    # --- bias: IREF into NMOS diode, mirrored to the two sinks (same gm/Id, L)
    mref = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=None or 0.6)
    mref = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=mref.vgs)
    mb1 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], I1, vds=vamp)
    mb2 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], Isf, vds=vin)

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("M1", "amp", "iin", "vdd", "vdd", m1)          # inverting gain stage
    n.dev("MB1", "amp", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)      # current-sink load
    n.dev("MSF", "vdd", "amp", "vout", "vss", msf)       # follower buffer (in loop)
    n.dev("MB2", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb2)
    n.R("RF", "vout", "iin", Rf)
    n.C("CF", "vout", "iin", Cf)

    # --- first-order performance model
    A0 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + mb1.gds)
    Asf = msf.gm / (msf.gm + msf.gmbs + msf.gds + mb2.gds)
    A = A0 * Asf
    Cout = m1.cdd + mb1.cdd + msf.cgd + 0.25 * msf.cgg + 2e-15
    Cin = cpd + m1.cgg + Cf
    w_in = 1.0 / (Rf * Cin)
    w_a = (m1.gds + mb1.gds) / Cout
    w_sf = msf.gm / (cl + mb2.cdd + msf.cgg * 0.2)
    # combine amp and SF poles into one effective pole (sum of time constants)
    w_eff = 1.0 / (1.0 / w_a + 1.0 / w_sf)
    w0 = math.sqrt((1 + A) * w_in * w_eff)
    Q = w0 / (w_in + w_eff)
    a = 1 - 1 / (2 * Q * Q)
    f3 = w0 / (2 * PI) * math.sqrt(a + math.sqrt(a * a + 1))
    f3 = min(f3, 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rf * Cf) * 1.5) if Cf > 0 else f3
    zt = Rf * A / (1 + A)

    # noise at 1 MHz: Rf thermal + amplifier voltage noise across Cin
    gamma = 0.8
    en2 = 4 * kT * gamma / m1.gm * (1 + mb1.gm / m1.gm)
    w1m = 2 * PI * 1e6
    in2 = 4 * kT / Rf + en2 * (w1m * Cin) ** 2
    power = VDD * (iref + I1 + Isf)

    return n, {
        "zt_dbohm": 20 * math.log10(zt),
        "f3db": f3,
        "power": power,
        "in_noise_1m": math.sqrt(in2),
        "vout_dc": vin,
        # diagnostics
        "A_loop": A, "Q": Q, "f0": w0 / (2 * PI), "f_sf": w_sf / (2 * PI),
        "vamp": vamp, "vsd1_margin": (VDD - vamp) - m1.vdsat,
    }
